descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
What begins as a rescue operation soon reveals something far worse: a deadly parasitic infection linked to Dr. Summers' secret experiments.

Explore abandoned houses, underground laboratories, infested streets, and hidden facilities as you fight to survive in a world descending into chaos.

**• Intense combat against infected creatures and monstrous mutations**

**• Diverse weapons, including pistols, rifles, axes, and hammers.**
[media]
**• Terrifying atmospheric environments**

Each location hides new threats. Every encounter could be your last.

Will you survive?

[media]
